reason: The current goal is to give the potato stems room, and the mesh may help support them as they grow.
expectation: I expect the mesh to be fitted to the potato trough as a support, though I’m unsure exactly how.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but I want to address the stated potato goal first.

effect: The mesh supports the spreading potato stems above the dark root cover, and the new goal is to taste the first harvest.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the grid give the stems support while the tubers continue developing.
reason: Harvesting the mature lettuce is the only offered combination and should advance the new goal.
expectation: I expect to cut lettuce from the trough, though tasting it may require another step.

effect: The scissors produced fresh lettuce leaves, ready for the next step toward tasting the harvest.
reaction: The result is straightforward, with no notable surprise.
reason: Using the leaves at the galley is the only offered combination and fits the goal of tasting them.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the lettuce at the galley, though I’m unsure whether that will complete the goal.

effect: The lettuce became part of a fresh meal, completing the harvest goal.
reaction: The sharp green smell against the barren view is a vivid, satisfying moment.

mostWorthwhile.text: Supporting the potato stems was the most worthwhile action: the result showed how the mesh supports spreading growth while the tubers remain covered.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce was straightforward but offered little detail on its own.

surprise.text: The contrast between the fresh green smell and the view outside made the harvest feel more significant.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the mesh, scissors and galley each had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the potatoes develop and how the expedition continues.
